content:
maria: Heads-up: planning rollout of stricter TLS profile across services next Tue 11:00 UTC. Goals: TLS1.3 only, remove RSA ciphers, enforce ECDHE, enable OCSP stapling and session-ticket rotation. Need to sync RBAC for cert-provisioner + KMS roles across regions. Any blockers?
cheng: Quick Q — does cert-provisioner need cross-region kms:Decrypt or just a local CMK per region? APAC had rotator unwrap failures last week.
audit-bot: audit-bot: detected region retention mismatch: apac=7d, eu=14d, us=30d. Filing ticket #SEC-1291 for retention parity.
oliver: From oncall: APAC handshake errors last week correlated with session-ticket eviction after rotator. Suggest staggered rollouts and keep fallback cipher enabled on canary for 48h.
maria: Agree. Proposed rollout: canary us-west1 -> monitor 24h, canary eu -> 24h, canary apac -> 48h; then global. Add a safety feature-flag to abort if we see issues. Who can own the flag?
kevin: I can own the flag (kevin). Flag should toggle config key `tls.strict_v2` at edge-proxy + ingress-ng. Add to runbook. Also suggest adding kms:DescribeKey to cert-provisioner to reduce noisy denies.
linda: Question: audit logs need to include KMS key alias + cert commonName for provenance. Are we ok with potential PII in logs if CN contains emails?
security-eng: We must redact CN when it contains user emails. For service certs ok. We should log a `cert_id` (hash) instead of raw CN for audit trails.
oliver: Small repro from APAC last week:
```json
{"ts":"6530000000","svc":"edge-proxy","err":"handshake alert 40","detail":"kms:Decrypt denied for key alias apac-rotator"}
```
cheng: Fix plan — add conditional IAM binding: apac-rotator SA -> kms:Decrypt on apac-cmk, and set short-lived STS for cross-region ops. Will test in staging.
maria: Action items: 1) kevin add feature-flag + docs; 2) cheng update IAM + test in staging; 3) audit-bot verify retention parity; 4) security-eng implement CN redaction/logging change. Owners + ETA?
kevin: ETA EOD Fri for feature-flag and docs.
cheng: ETA Mon for staging IAM tests, Tue for canary rollout start.
audit-bot: audit-bot: retention ticket updated — target parity by 2026-04-10. Notifying compliance and storage team.
security-eng: I'll land the CN-redaction PR and add unit tests. Also will add an observability metric `tls.handshake.failures.v2` tagged by region + cert_id.
maria: Thanks all. Reminder to add rollback playbook step: if `tls.handshake.failures.v2` spikes >5% for 15m, flip feature flag off and open a SEC incident.
oliver: :thumbsup: I'll add the alert in ops and a runbook link. Also recommend increasing session-ticket rotation window to 2h during rollout to avoid cache churn.
maria: Noted — I'll post final schedule once kevin confirms the feature-flag is deployed to staging.
